author: congh-nvidia

It looks like the vlan ping test tests/vlan/test_vlan_ping.py has not been adapted to dualtor topology.
The dut is randomly selected in the test, but either when the upper tor or the lower tor is selected, the test fails.

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run the vlan ping test on dualtor testbed
2.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**

linkedPullRequests.author: AnantKishorSharma

### Description of PR
1. vlan test enhancement for dualtor.
2. Enable “vlan/test_vlan.py::test_vlan_tc7_tagged_qinq_switch_on_outer_tag” for cisco-8000

Summary:
With this PR we can run vlan ping test on dualtor topo. Also, we have enabled “vlan/test_vlan.py::test_vlan_tc7_tagged_qinq_switch_on_outer_tag” for cisco-8000

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/9642 and https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/12302

### Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [ ] 202205
- [x] 202305
- [x] 202311
- [x] 202405

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
vlan ping test was failing on dualtor topo.

#### How did you do it?
enhanced the test case to run on dualtor topo

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified that the tests are passing  on dualtor-aa and standalone t0
